# openwrt_dhcp_boot (Resource)

A network boot (PXE) entry (`config boot`).

Manages a `boot` section in `/etc/config/dhcp`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filename` (String) Boot file name. (UCI option `filename`.)
- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `dhcp_option` (List of String) Extra DHCP options. (UCI option `dhcp_option`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `force` (Boolean) Always send the options. (UCI option `force`.)
- `networkid` (String) Only for this network id/tag. (UCI option `networkid`.)
- `serveraddress` (String) Boot server address. (UCI option `serveraddress`.)
- `servername` (String) Boot server name. (UCI option `servername`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
